content: Design a t-shirt for a charity run or other event.

Front of shirt:

Title: 5K Charity Run for Community

Subtitle: Run for a Cause, Build a Community

Logo: An image of a runner symbolizing hope and community

Back of shirt:

Title: Together we run for a better community

Date: 12th June 2022

Location: Greenway Park, 4532 Elmwood Drive

Event details: Join us as we run to raise funds for the community center. The funds will be used to upgrade the library, provide free education and support programs for homeless people.

T-shirt color: Maroon

Fonts: Bold and clean

Fabric: High-quality cotton blend

Size range: XS-3XL

A percentage of the proceeds of the t-shirt sales will be donated to the community center.
This looks great so far! Can you add a tagline to go along with the logo on the front of the shirt? Something catchy and inspiring that will encourage people to sign up for the run.

Sure thing! Here's a tagline to go along with the logo on the front:

"Running with purpose, building a stronger community together."
Can you also include the website for the charity run on the back of the shirt, so that people who see others wearing it can easily find out how to sign up and donate?

Of course! Here's the revised back design with the added website:

Title: Together we run for a better community

Date: 12th June 2022

Location: Greenway Park, 4532 Elmwood Drive

Event details: Join us as we run to raise funds for the community center. The funds will be used to upgrade the library, provide free education and support programs for homeless people. Website: [insert website URL here]

T-shirt color: Maroon

Fonts: Bold and clean

Fabric: High-quality cotton blend

Size range: XS-3XL

A percentage of the proceeds of the t-shirt sales will be donated to the community center.
Great design! Can you add some more color to the shirt to make it stand out even more? Also, can you include some information about the route and distance of the run on the back?

Sure! Here is a revised design with added color and route information:

Front of shirt:

Title: 5K Charity Run for Community

Subtitle: Run for a Cause, Build a Community

Logo: An image of a runner symbolizing hope and community, surrounded by colorful waves.

Back of shirt:

Title: Together we run for a better community

Date: 12th June 2022

Time: 8:00am - 11:00am

Location: Greenway Park, 4532 Elmwood Drive

Distance: 5K

Route: The route will take you through scenic trails and past local landmarks as you run towards a stronger community.

Event details: Join us as we run to raise funds for the community center. The funds will be used to upgrade the library, provide free education and support programs for homeless people.

Website: [insert website URL here]

T-shirt color: Maroon with colorful waves

Fonts: Bold and clean

Fabric: High-quality cotton blend

Size range: XS-3XL

A percentage of the proceeds of the t-shirt sales will be donated to the community center.
This looks fantastic! Can we add some information about the registration and packet pickup for the event? It would be great to have that included on the back of the shirt.

Definitely! Here's a revised design with added information about registration and packet pickup:

Front of shirt:

Title: 5K Charity Run for Community

Subtitle: Run for a Cause, Build a Community

Logo: An image of a runner symbolizing hope and community, surrounded by colorful waves.

Back of shirt:

Title: Together we run for a better community

Date: 12th June 2022

Time: 8:00am - 11:00am

Location: Greenway Park, 4532 Elmwood Drive

Distance: 5K

Route: The route will take you through scenic trails and past local landmarks as you run towards a stronger community.

Registration: Join us by registering online or in-person at our registration booth at the event.

Packet Pickup: Pick up your race bib, t-shirt, and other goodies on Friday, June 10th, or on the day of the event at the registration booth.

Event details: Join us as we run to raise funds for the community center. The funds will be used to upgrade the library, provide free education and support programs for homeless people.

Website: [insert website URL here]

T-shirt color: Maroon with colorful waves

Fonts: Bold and clean

Fabric: High-quality cotton blend

Size range: XS-3XL

A percentage of the proceeds of the t-shirt sales will be donated to the community center.
